playerTakes.author: TrentEndTom
playerTakes.body: Heart stopped when Haaland went round him, but Cunha had his back. Nothing he could do about Cherki's half-volley. Organised the back three well all night.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: He came out way too early for the Haaland chance. No Cunha on the line and it's 2-2. Forest fans calm down, your keeper got lucky.

playerTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
playerTakes.body: @BlueMoonRising_MCFC Closing the angle IS the job mate. Your 1.96m keeper flapped at a corner, maybe look at him first.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Sels tonight: best seat in the house to watch Jair Cunha play goalkeeper.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Matz Sels, honorary Gooner. Six points clear, thank you sir.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: No silly errors with his feet in that rain, which is half the battle. A few decent long ones up to Delap as well.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Ehrlich gesagt solide, mehr nicht. Beim Gegentor chancenlos, aber auch keine Glanzparade. City hatte einfach zu wenig Torchancen, das liegt nicht an ihm.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: City losing at the City Ground. Says City right there on the tin, should've been home advantage 😂

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: 167 days without a home goal and the keeper never looked rattled. Constantly talking, constantly shifting the back three.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: "Great organisation"? Rewatch Cherki's goal. Nobody on the edge of the box. Keeper should be screaming at someone there.

playerTakes.author: ColombianExpressNFFC
playerTakes.body: Went toe to toe with Doku all first half. The double-team was executed perfectly, Doku got nowhere.

playerTakes.author: DokuDribbleSchool
playerTakes.body: One switch from Doku in the second half and that side was open. That's where the Cherki goal came from. He got subbed for a reason.

playerTakes.author: TrentEndTom
playerTakes.body: @DokuDribbleSchool One switch = 'open'? What about Doku dragging that early chance wide, was that dribbling too much as well?

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Muñoz sprintet durch den Regen, als würde er den letzten Bus nach Hause verpassen.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Pace in transition is his big weapon, delivery was average though. Faded in the second half, sub made sense.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Better defensively than I expected. Offered us basically nothing going the other way though.

playerTakes.author: SelhurstEagle
playerTakes.body: Glasner literally copy-pasted our wing-back system to Forest. Muñoz: same recipe, same chef.

playerTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
playerTakes.body: Best gift Glasner brought us: a Colombian who never stops sprinting.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: How many of his crosses found a man? A wing-back who only has pace wouldn't make our bench.

playerTakes.author: KopEnd_Scouser
playerTakes.body: Textbook way to handle a winger like Doku. Shut the inside first, then show him the line.

playerTakes.author: GaribaldiReds
playerTakes.body: Classic Murillo. Carried it out of the back in the rain and broke City's first press a few times on his own.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: Massive gap at the edge of the box for Cherki. Three centre-backs standing in a line watching. Spare me the 'ball-playing' talk.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: @SkyBlueTilIDie That's a second ball at the top of the box, is the CB meant to leave the six-yard box? Your two CBs were hooked at half-time, sort your own house out.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Held his own physically against Haaland. Never let him get comfortable with his back to goal.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Murillo, friend of Arsenal FC. Please don't sell him to City in January.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: How to mark Haaland, by Murillo: stay tight, stay tighter, then wait for Cunha to sweep up.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Ein paar Zweikämpfe waren ziemlich ungestüm, Glück mit der großzügigen Linie des Schiris. Insgesamt aber in Ordnung.

playerTakes.author: RamsHorn1884
playerTakes.body: City played like a pub team. Any normal PL side and Forest leak like a sieve as usual.

playerTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
playerTakes.body: @RamsHorn1884 Here come the sheep. Get back in the Premier League before you rate our centre-backs.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Honestly United have wanted this lad for ages. Another steady one tonight.

playerTakes.author: MilenkoTower
playerTakes.body: Won pretty much everything in the air. City crossed a lot in the second half and most of it came straight back out.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Big lad can head it. That's it. Build-up = hoof.

playerTakes.author: TrentEndTom
playerTakes.body: @BlueMoonRising_MCFC 'Hoof' started the move for the second goal. You had 70%+ of the ball and scored once. How's the tiki-taka working out?

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Milenkovićs Kopfballradius umfasst ungefähr ganz Nottingham inklusive Vororte.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Really clear organiser in the middle of the three. When Cunha or Murillo stepped out he always stayed home.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Did his job. Haaland's big chance came from our midfield collapsing, not from him.

playerTakes.author: BridgeBlue_CFC
playerTakes.body: Milenković was more stable against City than City's own defence.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: Biggest job tonight was stopping Haaland holding it up. Won most of the high balls.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: Forest fans giving 8s, wake up. Dry day and City's passing works, your back line gets torn apart.

playerTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
playerTakes.body: Rain + Milenković = where City crosses go to die.

playerTakes.author: GaribaldiReds
playerTakes.body: MOTM shout. Pounces on 5 minutes for his first Forest goal, then clears Haaland's shot off the line on 41. Decisive at both ends.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Gvardiol gift-wrapped the goal, anyone scores that. Haaland hit the clearance straight at him. Calm down with the legend talk.

playerTakes.author: TrentEndTom
playerTakes.body: @BlueMoonRising_MCFC Haaland is past the keeper and it gets cleared off the line and you call that 'hit straight at him'? Just admit he saved the game.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: CB goal + goal-line clearance. Cunha did the striker's job AND the keeper's job. Pay the man three wages.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Jair Cunha is now an honorary Arsenal player. That clearance was worth six points.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: People doubted him since he arrived. Answered all of it tonight. Read everything, barely out of position.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Muss man neidlos anerkennen: die Rettung auf der Linie war perfekt antizipiert. Einer der Wendepunkte des Spiels.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Cunha: just came to play centre-back, cleaned up Man City on the side.

playerTakes.author: RamsHorn1884
playerTakes.body: Taps in a gift and he's a god now? Low bar at Forest.

playerTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
playerTakes.body: @RamsHorn1884 When did a Derby centre-back last score in the Premier League? Go check the history books.

playerTakes.author: RedDragonNeco
playerTakes.body: Really disciplined on the left. Between him and Schlager, Ndiaye had nothing.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: Fine first half, struggled once we switched play more after the break. Average overall.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: @SkyBlueTilIDie Apart from one switch what did you actually do second half? The ones struggling were your full-backs, both hooked at HT.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Neco Williams: the best full-back on the pitch wearing the wrong shade of red for City.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: Didn't get forward much, Glasner clearly wanted the left wing-back to protect. Did it well.

playerTakes.author: KopEnd_Scouser
playerTakes.body: Academy lads from Anfield know how to defend against City. Family recipe.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: No big mistakes, nothing eye-catching either. Pass mark.

playerTakes.author: TrentEndTom
playerTakes.body: Biggest risk in that rain is slipping and losing your man. Can't remember him getting cleanly beaten once.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Can United get a wing-back this reliable please. Begging.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Against a winger in proper form he gets cooked.

playerTakes.author: AcademyLadNFFC
playerTakes.body: Captain's shift for 90 minutes. Huge ground covered, killed Enzo's and Anderson's runs again and again.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: He's a runner. Not one good pass all game. If he starts in the PL your midfield is empty.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: @BlueMoonRising_MCFC The 'runner' ran your big-money midfield into the ground. So what does that make them?

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Yates' Laufleistung heute: einmal Nottingham–Manchester und zurück, gefühlt.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Passing isn't his strength but his job is letting Schlager play. Roles were crystal clear tonight.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Grafter. That type thrives in the rain, dragged our midfield into a mud fight.

playerTakes.author: RamsHorn1884
playerTakes.body: Forest's midfield tactic: Yates charges at someone, everyone else prays.

playerTakes.author: AcademyLadNFFC
playerTakes.body: @RamsHorn1884 If praying worked Derby would've been promoted years ago.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Yates treating City's midfield like a League Cup second round.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: A homegrown captain's value isn't in the stats. Watch him dragging the others up the pitch.

playerTakes.author: WienerForestFan
playerTakes.body: Glasners Landsmann hat im Regen den Rhythmus perfekt gesteuert: rausnehmen, wenn nötig, und dann mit einem Pass den Konter einleiten.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: 'Metronome' lmao. Sideways and backwards all night.

playerTakes.author: TrentEndTom
playerTakes.body: @SkyBlueTilIDie Sideways and backwards? You had 70%+ possession, you ARE the sideways and backwards champions.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Schlager heißt auf Deutsch Hit. Und Forest hat heute definitiv einen gelandet.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Perfect partner for Yates. One wins it, one plays it. City never got comfortable in there.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Not flashy, barely gave it away. That kind of reliability is exactly what our midfield lacked.

playerTakes.author: SelhurstEagle
playerTakes.body: Glasner's Austrian football finally blooming in the PL. Schlager is basically his avatar on the pitch.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: Several turns in midfield made City's press look silly. First pass in the counters was often his.

playerTakes.author: KopEnd_Scouser
playerTakes.body: An Austrian in an English monsoon, completely unbothered. Alpine training.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: City were just awful. Normal City and this midfield never sees the ball.

playerTakes.author: ExBlueNowRed
playerTakes.body: Worked so hard against his old club. Skying MGW's cut-back is the only regret, could've been game over after 20.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Came back to prove a point, skied a sitter and got booked. This is why we let him go.

playerTakes.author: TrentEndTom
playerTakes.body: @BlueMoonRising_MCFC Who in your front line worked harder than him? One miss and the whole game doesn't count?

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: McAtee's finish: still a bit of loyalty left for the old club.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Ex-City academy lad putting it into the stands. As a United fan, we understand this feeling deeply.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Clever receiving in the half-space, he was the second link in most counters. Sub was about fitness.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Die Gelbe für das Foul an Anderson war unnötig hektisch. Aber körperlich deutlich robuster als bei uns damals.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: That yellow was a tactical foul. Stop Anderson or we're facing a break. City fans, stop playing the victim.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: McAtee: just popped back to see old friends and play a little prank on them.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Laufwege und Übersicht stimmen, der letzte Kontakt bleibt seine Baustelle.

playerTakes.author: MGW10forever
playerTakes.body: Man of the match. Every big counter went through him, and the run + pass for the third killed the game.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Bullied Khusanov, that's all. Proper right-back and he's invisible.

playerTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
playerTakes.body: @BlueMoonRising_MCFC Who picked Khusanov at right-back? Maresca?

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Gibbs-White turned Saturday into a Black Saturday for City.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: The cut-back for McAtee was brilliant vision, shame it wasn't finished. Dropped deep to help when we were under siege too.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: The one Forest player who scared me. Every break ran through him.

playerTakes.author: LaneCockerel
playerTakes.body: The man who nearly joined Spurs proving once again that not joining Spurs was the right call.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: When MGW slipped Delap in, I could feel that six-point gap from my sofa.

playerTakes.author: RamsHorn1884
playerTakes.body: One assist and he's MOTM? Championship players make that pass.

playerTakes.author: MGW10forever
playerTakes.body: @RamsHorn1884 Get your Championship players into the Premier League first.

playerTakes.author: RevengeOfTheEx
playerTakes.body: Brace against his old club! Second one, left foot into the far corner, top-class finish that ended the game.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: First one came from our own giveaway, defence asleep. He just cashed in.

playerTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
playerTakes.body: @BlueMoonRising_MCFC A 50-yard carry is 'cashing in'? You subbed two centre-backs and still couldn't stop him.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: His dad terrorised the PL with long throws. Liam does it with his feet. Family business upgraded.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: City academy's real purpose: developing players to beat City.

playerTakes.author: RevengeOfTheEx
playerTakes.body: Not just the goals. His pressing bothered Dias and Guéhi all night, Guéhi kept getting dragged into fouls.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Muss man zugeben: starkes Spiel. Beide Tore waren hochwertige Abschlüsse.

playerTakes.author: BridgeBlue_CFC
playerTakes.body: Delap at Chelsea: where is he? Delap at Forest: in City's net.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Delap's goals are being celebrated in Arsenal group chats like Christmas came early.

playerTakes.author: RamsHorn1884
playerTakes.body: Struggled since he signed, one game and he's a legend? Let's see it for a month.

playerTakes.author: Waldfreund_Zürich
playerTakes.body: Nach der Einwechslung viel Defensivarbeit geleistet, und im Umschaltspiel hat sein Tempo Citys Abwehr unter Druck gesetzt.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: Came on and ran around. Nothing to do with the third goal.

playerTakes.author: TrentEndTom
playerTakes.body: @SkyBlueTilIDie Holding on while under siege IS the contribution. What did your subs do?

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Ndoyes Hauptaufgabe nach der Einwechslung: Citys Außenverteidiger beim Joggen begleiten.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Got at them once or twice down the flank but rushed the final decision. Needs a calmer head.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Tracks back well. Not much of a threat going forward.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Swiss precision: on time, off the bench, shutting City's flank down.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: Good timing from Glasner. Ndoye's pace stopped City's full-backs pushing too high.

playerTakes.author: KopEnd_Scouser
playerTakes.body: City were battering them when he came on, so he became a sixth defender.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Solid sub cameo, did what he was told.

playerTakes.author: Fohlen_im_Wald
playerTakes.body: Kam rein, um links zu stabilisieren. Zusammen mit Milenković hat er Citys Angriffe in der zweiten Halbzeit mehrfach entschärft.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Just came on to fill a gap. Zero impact.

playerTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
playerTakes.body: @BlueMoonRising_MCFC A defender you didn't get past is 'zero impact'? That's literally the job.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Netz kam rein, und City hat das Netz danach nicht mehr gefunden. Nomen est omen.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: Barely put a foot wrong, stayed switched on through City's best spell.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Positionally fine, offered nothing going forward.

playerTakes.author: RamsHorn1884
playerTakes.body: Netz's contribution: Forest fans now know the name of one more sub.

playerTakes.author: TrentEndTom
playerTakes.body: @RamsHorn1884 Quiet day in Derby is it? Rating our subs now.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Netz came on to knit the net shut, not to let City go fishing.

playerTakes.author: KopEnd_Scouser
playerTakes.body: Steady sub whose job was to lock the game. Done.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Couldn't do much about the goals but that flap at the corner nearly cost us another.

playerTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
playerTakes.body: A 1.96m keeper flapping at a corner. Funniest moment of the night.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: @BridgfordBoy All three were gifts from the back line. Mocking the keeper is all you've got.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Donnarumma's night was like a Nottingham weather forecast: promised sunshine, got rain.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Donnarumma: I stand here. The defence handles the conceding.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Bei so einer löchrigen Abwehr steht der Keeper extrem unter Druck. Aber sein Herauslaufen muss besser werden.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Donnarumma: wasn't this busy in a Champions League final with PSG.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: Angle wasn't huge for Delap's second, felt like he got down slowly.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: @CityGroundSeasonTkt 'Slow'? Watch the replay, it goes in off the inside of the post.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Nicht der Hauptgrund für die Niederlage, aber er hat auch nichts gerettet.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Bullied by Gibbs-White's strength and pace. Better once he moved inside after the break but still a struggle.

playerTakes.author: MGW10forever
playerTakes.body: Khusanov debut vs Chelsea: the sequel. MGW took him to school.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: @MGW10forever Laughing at a 22-year-old, real classy. He held up fine at CB after the break.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Khusanov's collection: humbled by Chelsea ✅ humbled by Forest ✅ Liverpool next to complete the set.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Centre-back playing right-back was always going to be awkward. That's on the manager more than him.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Strong physically but stiff on the turn, half a second slow.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: When Khusanov's on the pitch, every winger feels like Messi.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Saw Khusanov at right-back on the teamsheet and grabbed the popcorn.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Mock him all you want, how many lads that young in your squad would front up like that?

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Tempo ist da, aber Stellungsspiel und Entscheidungen brauchen noch viele Spiele.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Better than both full-backs, but organising the line was a mess. Lost runners behind him a few times.

playerTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
playerTakes.body: Former PL defender of the season, carved open by Delap running half the pitch.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: @BridgfordBoy We'd already lost it in midfield, he got pulled out of position. Nobody stops that alone.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Dias tonight: steamed-up windscreen in the rain. Saw nothing.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Dias: once City's wall, now Arsenal's helper.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Vor dem 0:2 wurde er durch den langen Ball aus der Position gezogen. Das war der entscheidende Fehler.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Still strong in the air but all over the place on the ground.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Since when do Dias and Maguire share a brain?

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: @StretfordRain United fan talking about defenders, sort your own back line out.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Die Führungsqualität ist noch da, aber das war kein Abwehrchef-Auftritt.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Delap dragged him into foul after foul. Half-time sub made sense.

playerTakes.author: RevengeOfTheEx
playerTakes.body: Guéhi's night: chased around by Delap, then sent for a sit-down.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: @RevengeOfTheEx Half-time change was tactical, not because he was bad. Know ball?

playerTakes.author: SelhurstEagle
playerTakes.body: Glasner watching Guéhi from the touchline like: I never made you run this much at Palace.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Guéhi looked a lot more relaxed on the bench in the second half.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Fine physically but got dragged into a wrestling match and baited into too many fouls.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Guéhi: came to City to win titles, not to stand in the Nottingham rain.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Not first in line for blame on either first-half goal, but couldn't rescue anything either.

playerTakes.author: RamsHorn1884
playerTakes.body: Only City player who won today: got to come in out of the rain at half-time.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Unter den Erwartungen. Muss sich im nächsten Spiel neu beweisen.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Robbed in midfield on 5 minutes, straight goal. Wrecked the game plan from the start. Sub was obvious.

playerTakes.author: GaribaldiReds
playerTakes.body: Thanks Gvardiol for gifting Cunha his first Forest goal. We'll never forget it.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: @GaribaldiReds One mistake and he's finished? Who in your squad has done what he's done?

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Gvardiol carrying it through midfield like a man driving the wrong way down the M1.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Gvardiol with the first assist of the game. Wrong team, but still.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Way too casual under pressure. Inverting the left-back into midfield was the weak spot tonight.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Gvardiol: just adding a bit of drama to the script.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Einer der Tiefpunkte seiner Karriere. Hoffentlich findet er schnell wieder zu sich.

playerTakes.author: BridgeBlue_CFC
playerTakes.body: Five minutes in and he's already handing out presents. Christmas came early in Nottingham.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Fehler zum 0:1, zur Pause raus. Das fasst seinen Abend zusammen.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: Going back to Forest is pressure. Lost it with Gvardiol for the opener, better after that.

playerTakes.author: AcademyLadNFFC
playerTakes.body: Leaves for City, comes back and gives us a goal. Cheers Elliot, still loyal.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: @AcademyLadNFFC He starts for City. Which of your midfielders would start for City?

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Anderson back at the City Ground: came to see old friends, old friends gave him a lesson.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: Still one of ours in a way, hurt a bit to watch the mistake. But that's football.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Zuletzt richtig stark, heute sichtlich von Emotionen und Regen beeinflusst. McAtees Tritt hat ihm auch nicht geholfen.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Anderson: came home, gave the ball back too.

playerTakes.author: RamsHorn1884
playerTakes.body: City pay big for a Forest player and then lose at Forest. Derby fans will be laughing about this for a year.

playerTakes.author: TrentEndTom
playerTakes.body: The mix-up with Ndiaye before the second is on him too. City fans, stop saying he's blameless.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Unter seinem aktuellen Niveau, aber nicht der Hauptschuldige.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: Moved it efficiently, early header just over. Our steadiest midfielder by a distance.

playerTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
playerTakes.body: Loads of touches, zero threat. Safe pass after safe pass, never dared to risk it against our midfield.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: @BridgfordBoy Safe passing is control. A team with under 30% of the ball wouldn't get it.

playerTakes.author: BridgeBlue_CFC
playerTakes.body: Enzo, Chelsea to City: the one thing that didn't change is possession without shooting.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: That early header: almost in. Football doesn't do almost.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Has the tempo but no line-breaking pass against our low block.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Above pass mark. Needs more late runs and through balls to actually hurt teams.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: World Cup winner, still couldn't find a passing lane in rainy Nottingham.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: One of the few City players who kept his head.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Stabil, aber ohne entscheidende Aktion. Kein Ausfall, kein Unterschied.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: Smothered by Forest's wing-back, created nothing. Mix-up with Anderson before the second goal too.

playerTakes.author: RedDragonNeco
playerTakes.body: Ndiaye's role tonight: padding Neco Williams' defensive stats.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: @RedDragonNeco He was double-teamed. You needed two men on him, says plenty.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Ndiaye: came to City to prove himself, ended up proving he doesn't like rain.

playerTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
playerTakes.body: No spark on the wing, lazy tracking back, and the miscommunication with Anderson for the second was fatal.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Still adapting. Net negative tonight.

playerTakes.author: GoodisonGhost
playerTakes.body: Ndiaye leaves Everton and finds out you can lose to Forest at City too.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Invisibility perfected. City should fit him with a GPS tracker.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Squeezed between wing-back and midfielder, never got a clean ball.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Kaum präsent. Muss im City-System erst noch seine Rolle finden.

playerTakes.author: CherkiMagique
playerTakes.body: Best City player by miles. That half-volley was a worldie. Quiet first half, took over after the break.

playerTakes.author: TrentEndTom
playerTakes.body: One goal, ghost for 45 minutes, high rating only because of one swing.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: @TrentEndTom Best strike of the game. Were Delap's goals that hard?

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Cherki's half-volley: French romance. Doesn't win you points though.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Cherki reminding us someone at City is actually playing football.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Only City player who worried me. Kept finding pockets at the top of the box in the second half.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Er braucht mehr Ballkontakte. Die zweite Halbzeit zeigt, dass er der kreative Kern sein muss.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Cherki playing like it's Lyon again. Teammates didn't get the memo.

playerTakes.author: GerlandGone
playerTakes.body: Lyon kids are all like this. Talent off the charts, consistency the question. Second half showed exactly why City paid.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Einer der Lichtblicke. Tor von höchster Qualität, aber die erste Halbzeit zeigt, dass das System ihn zu wenig einbindet.

playerTakes.author: DokuDribbleSchool
playerTakes.body: First half the double-team really hurt him. The switch for Cherki's goal shows what he brings.

playerTakes.author: ColombianExpressNFFC
playerTakes.body: Doku: dribbled all game, one useful pass.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: @ColombianExpressNFFC That one pass made a goal. Did Muñoz create one?

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Doku's dribbling is dancing in the rain. Pretty, but no destination.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Doku: best dribbler at City, no idea what happens after the dribble.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Dragged an early chance wide, then got double-teamed into nothing. Better second half.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Decision-making after beating his man is still where the biggest gains are.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Doku reminds me of a certain United winger. At least Doku had one good switch.

playerTakes.author: KopEnd_Scouser
playerTakes.body: Talent is obvious, but too predictable in combination play.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Durchwachsen. Gegen einen tiefen Block braucht er mehr Variabilität.

playerTakes.author: BlueNorwegianViking
playerTakes.body: Went round Sels on 41 and Cunha cleared it off the line, then the curler early second half nearly went in. Just not his night.

playerTakes.author: GaribaldiReds
playerTakes.body: Gets round the keeper and still doesn't score. The Terminator got unplugged.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: @GaribaldiReds It was cleared off the line, not missed. Cunha half a second late and it's 2-2.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Haaland's stat line: 0 goals, 1 'so close', 1 'so close again'.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Thank you Erling for taking the night off. Arsenal fans are sending you an honorary shirt.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Movement still elite but squeezed between Milenković and Cunha, never got a clean shot away.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Ohne Unterstützung aus dem Mittelfeld kann er Forests Abwehr allein nicht knacken.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Proof that robots short-circuit in the rain.

playerTakes.author: KopEnd_Scouser
playerTakes.body: Made the chances he could, just lacked a bit of luck in the finish.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Nicht schlecht, aber für den Topstürmer ist null Tore das Problem.

playerTakes.author: CFAkidsMCFC
playerTakes.body: Brought energy at half-time, much more positive going forward on the left than Gvardiol.

playerTakes.author: Fohlen_im_Wald
playerTakes.body: Eingewechselt und nichts verändert. City wurde in der zweiten Halbzeit trotzdem ausgekontert.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: @Fohlen_im_Wald We had most of the ball after the break and the left side stopped making basic errors once he came on.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: O'Reilly's only aim when coming on: don't become Gvardiol 2.0.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Bombed on well, but struggled getting back when we countered.

playerTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
playerTakes.body: Young lad taking responsibility. One of the few positives.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: Finally a City academy player who came on and didn't get memed.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Positive, but the game was already slipping away.

playerTakes.author: KopEnd_Scouser
playerTakes.body: Two big-name defenders off at half-time, two subs on. Maresca's youth revolution.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Ordentlicher Joker-Einsatz, aber ohne Einfluss auf den Spielverlauf.

playerTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
playerTakes.body: On at right-back at the break. Carried it forward fine, but he and Anderson were both left behind on the counter for the third.

playerTakes.author: MGW10forever
playerTakes.body: Nunes' biggest contribution: background extra for MGW and Delap's highlight reel.

playerTakes.author: SkyBlueTilIDie
playerTakes.body: @MGW10forever Whole team was pushed up, nobody catches that break. Don't judge him on one goal.

playerTakes.author: PLNightOwl
playerTakes.body: Midfielder-to-right-back conversion still under construction. Running back in that rain looked like wading through a swamp.

playerTakes.author: MolineuxHowl
playerTakes.body: Nunes after leaving Wolves: new position, same way of getting countered.

playerTakes.author: SherwoodArrow
playerTakes.body: Can carry the ball, but a right-back's defensive instincts just aren't there.

playerTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
playerTakes.body: Als Aushilfs-Rechtsverteidiger hat er sein Bestes gegeben. Das Problem ist das System.

playerTakes.author: N5Popcorn
playerTakes.body: City's back line tonight was one big substitution experiment.

playerTakes.author: StretfordRain
playerTakes.body: Average. Didn't give any defensive security.

playerTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
playerTakes.body: Gut im Vorwärtsgang, aber die verlorene Rückwärtsbewegung beim 3:1 zeigt die defensive Schwäche.

matchTakes.author: CityGroundSeasonTkt
matchTakes.body: 167 days without a home goal, then 3-1 against City in the pouring rain. City Ground was rocking. First time Glasner's counter game fully clicked.

matchTakes.author: BlueMoonRising_MCFC
matchTakes.body: Two of the three were self-inflicted. Forest weren't good, City collapsed.

matchTakes.author: BridgfordBoy
matchTakes.body: @BlueMoonRising_MCFC Lose and it's 'we collapsed', win and it's 'quality'. Three league defeats in a row and still in denial.

matchTakes.author: N5Popcorn
matchTakes.body: Game of the season, no debate. Six points. Thank you Forest, thank you Delap, thank you Cunha.

matchTakes.author: Fußball_Statistiker
matchTakes.body: Hochklassiges Spiel. Zwei frühe Fehler gaben die Richtung vor, Cherkis Traumtor und Cunhas Rettung auf der Linie bleiben hängen.

matchTakes.author: EtihadOldTimer
matchTakes.body: 70%+ possession and this happens. Maresca needs answers fast, the defensive combinations are a huge problem.

matchTakes.author: StretfordRain
matchTakes.body: City lose three on the bounce. As a United fan my weekend just went full technicolour.

matchTakes.author: RamsHorn1884
matchTakes.body: Don't get carried away Forest, long way to go in the relegation fight. One win over City means nothing.

matchTakes.author: TrentEndTom
matchTakes.body: @RamsHorn1884 At least we're fighting relegation in the Premier League. Get us an East Midlands derby back first.

matchTakes.author: KopEnd_Scouser
matchTakes.body: Two ex-City academy boys (Delap, McAtee) plus ex-Forest Anderson going home. Couldn't have scripted it better.

matchTakes.author: SelhurstEagle
matchTakes.body: Glasner sprinting into that celebration had half of Selhurst in tears.

matchTakes.author: Citizen_aus_Köln
matchTakes.body: Man hätte schon nach 15 Minuten reagieren müssen. Zur Pause zwei Verteidiger zu tauschen war zu spät.
